Its EEG signature shows absence of β_l (+7.8 dB, sensitivity=9.1) and suppressed α (-1.7 dB, sensitivity=8.8).
The β_l activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 0% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is conflicting with N2 physiology: missing: σ relevant, EOG quiescent. Note: model primarily uses β_l, atypical for N2.
